t: Robust Forge Steel plumbing spanner engineered for the installation and maintenance of compression fittings. Constructed from durable, drop-forged steel and zinc-plated for corrosion resistance. Provides reliable performance for professional plumbers and heating engineers working on domestic and commercial pipework. The metric spanner features a twin-ended design specifically sized for 15mm and 22mm compression fitting nuts, ensuring a precise and secure grip, and 180mm length to allow ample leverage. Ideal for demanding trade use.
